[ENG] What if Park Bo-young Gets 150 Billion Won? 💸  GOLDLAND Press Con (Park Bo-young/Lee Kwang-soo

Welcome to the press conference for Disney+'s new original survival thriller, ⟨GOLDLAND⟩! ✨
Ordinary customs officer Kim Hee-ju (Park Bo-young) accidentally gets her hands on 150 billion won worth of gold bars, sparking a ruthless battle for survival! From Park Bo-young putting aside her "Lovable" title for a dry, gritty transformation, to Lee Kwang-soo turning dark with a "tooth gem," and the intense tension brought by Kim Sung-cheol, Lee Hyun-wook, Kim Hee-won, and Moon Jeong-hee!
